(rule!
  (let* ((palette (list 2 4 6 7 3 5 9))
         (frames (sort (filter (lambda (obj) (= (obj-color obj) 8)) (objects g 0))
                       (lambda (a b)
                         (> (* (obj-h a) (obj-w a)) (* (obj-h b) (obj-w b)))))))
    (let loop ([out (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0)] [remaining frames] [depth 0])
      (if (empty? remaining)
          out
          (loop (paint-cells out (obj-cells (first remaining)) (nth palette depth))
                (rest remaining)
                (+ depth 1))))))
